brand_safety: Preserve official packshots exactly as supplied — no shape, color, or label alterations
Preserve official logos, typography, and brand identity at every frame
Do not invent claims, benefits, or regulatory language not present in approved briefing
Do not generate fake regulatory text (ANVISA, RDC, nutrition facts, etc.)
Do not use direct celebrity likeness — convert to generic casting descriptions
Never move an asset to production unless all required inputs are confirmed present
visual_style: Ultra-premium CGI product advertising — photorealistic, high micro-contrast
Cinematic lighting with soft volumetric fills and branded gradient backgrounds
Clean product readability — packaging legible at every frame
LED-safe composition — high contrast, no overexposure, readable claims at safe margins
Product-first framing — packshot is always the visual anchor
Anamorphic lens language permitted for cinematic depth — no distortion of product
Safe area: 10% margin on all edges for LED panel edge bleed
Floating ingredient particles, light arcs, molecular overlays allowed as supporting elements only
technical_rules: Primary format: 1792x1536 for P1.9 7x6 Mod (LED 1 Curvo)
Audio: None for LED 1 Curvo (15s no audio). AAC2 if required by specific screen
Duration: 15s LED 1 Curvo — split into two clips: 8s + 7s
Max clip per generation: 8 seconds (Veo 3.1 model limit)

first_last_frame_workflow.note: CONFIRMED to support first + last frame. Use for LED 1 Curvo 8s clips.

text_to_video_workflow.note: Veo 3 Highest Quality does NOT support first+last frame. Use for text-only scenes.

approval_gates: Gate 1 — Asset audit complete and signed off
Gate 2 — Briefing alignment complete and signed off
Gate 4 — Scene descriptions approved by user
Gate 5 — Initial/final frame prompts approved by user
Gate 6 — JSON prompt approved by user
Gate 7 — Video generation complete and raw output stored
Gate 9 — Tracker updated with CONFIRMED status
Gate 10 — Final delivery packaged and handed off
